maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from new RVs (travel trailers, fifth wheels, motorhomes) sold via dealers; parts and service are minor.

publicly_funded.reason: RVs are bought by consumers through dealers, with private retail financing; government is not the payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling RVs from its brands, such as Jayco, Airstream and Heartland; acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Dealers and consumers can switch among competing RV brands easily; RVs are discretionary leisure purchases.
